title: Miellerie du Val Perdu
brief: Skill new-example with no argument, which means picking a usecase nobody has done yet. Resolved to: an artisanal honey house (lp-miellerie), porting four pmndrs demos — inter-epoxy-resin for the honey, volumetric-spotlight for the beams, instances for the comb, tying-canvas-to-scroll-offset for the rig.
